scope: Stage-2 authority, exact pinned tree, README, environment, split manifests, representative training/evaluation/inference code and primary-paper summary inspected statically. No environment, data, model or notebook was executed or loaded.

unresolved_findings.finding: No repository license defines reuse terms for the published code.
The active training loop clears gradients immediately before optimizer.step and never calls GradScaler.step/update, blocking parameter updates without repair.
The evaluation loop labels its metrics container RRDB while loading SPSR weights and writing SPSR result paths.
IXI volumes and pretrained weights are external, were not access-validated, and lack repository-pinned checksums.
Training and inference depend on user-specific absolute paths, unconditional CUDA calls and an uncreated Models output directory.
README activation names s2l8h while environment.yml declares srmri and exports a user-specific prefix.

notes: Paper performance statements remain primary-paper scoped and do not override code-level conflicts.
